metadata.title: fix(ui): convert inline event handlers to addEventListener for innerHTML guard compatibility (#3372)
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR
Closes #3372

---

## 📌 Summary
`installInnerHtmlGuard()` (PR #3129) strips all inline `on*` event attributes from HTML set via `innerHTML` for XSS protection. This breaks every dynamically loaded UI element that relied on inline `onclick`/`onchange` handlers.

Most visible symptom: team selector dropdown items in the admin header are unclickable.

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
1. Log in to admin UI
2. Click the team selector dropdown in the header
3. Click any team in the list
4. Nothing happens — no navigation, no console errors, no network request

## 🐞 Root Cause
`installInnerHtmlGuard()` in `admin.js` (PR #3129) overrides `Element.prototype.innerHTML` to strip all `on*` attributes for XSS protection. When `loadTeams()` sets `container.innerHTML = html`, the `onclick="selectTeamFromSelector(this)"` on each `.team-selector-item` button is removed.

## 💡 Fix Description
Converted all affected inline `onclick`/`onchange` attributes to `data-action` attributes, then attached event listeners via `addEventListener` after each innerHTML assignment. Uses event delegation where appropriate (tables, lists).

### Affected locations (all fixed):
1. **Team selector dropdown** — event delegation on `#team-selector-items`
2. **Team selector search error retry** — addEventListener after innerHTML
3. **Team selector loadTeams error retry** (admin.html) — addEventListener after innerHTML
4. **Metrics error/retry buttons** — data-action + addEventListener
5. **Metrics empty state retry** — data-action + addEventListener
6. **Tag filter clear button** — data-action + addEventListener
7. **Auth header toggle/remove buttons** — data-action + addEventListener
8. **Import file chooser reset** — data-action + addEventListener
9. **Token list error retry** — data-action + addEventListener
10. **Token usage stats modal close** — data-action + addEventListener
11. **Bulk import selection controls** — data-action + addEventListener (select all/none/custom, reset, preview, import, checkbox onchange)
12. **Tool table action buttons** — event delegation on `#toolBody` (enrich, generate tests, validate, view, edit)
13. **Global search results** — addEventListener after innerHTML
14. **Public team join buttons** — addEventListener after innerHTML
15. **Chat server selection** — addEventListener after innerHTML
16. **Log viewer rows + correlation trace** — event delegation on tbody
17. **Security events correlation trace** — addEventListener after innerHTML
18. **Audit trail correlation trace** — addEventListener after innerHTML

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Playwright regression test            | `pytest ...::TestTeamSelectorDropdown` | ✅ |
| URL contains `?team_id=` after click  | manual + Playwright  | ✅ |
| Existing team/org tests               | `pytest test_organization.py` | ✅ |
| No remaining inline onclick in innerHTML strings | Verified via grep | ✅ |

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Root cause identified and verified with Playwright
- [x] All innerHTML+onclick paths converted to data-action + addEventListener
- [x] Regression test added
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review: Approve

Thoroughly reviewed, rebased, tested, and augmented this PR. The core approach — converting inline `onclick`/`onchange` handlers to `data-action` + `addEventListener`/event delegation — is correct and well-executed.

### Bugs found and fixed during review

1. **`selectServerForChat()` used `item.onclick.toString()`** — With inline onclick removed, `item.onclick` is `null` and this throws `TypeError`. Fixed: replaced with `item.dataset.serverId === serverId`.

2. **`enrichTool()`/`generateToolTestCases()` unguarded null-deref** — The PR converted `loadTools()` markup from `onclick` to `data-action`, but the button-state selectors (`[onclick*="enrichTool(...)"]`) in these functions still used the old pattern, returning `null`. Lines 12244/12552 then crashed with `TypeError`. Fixed: updated selectors to `[data-action="enrich-tool"][data-tool-id="..."]` and added null guards.

3. **`toolops_partial.html` still had inline `onclick`** — This server-rendered HTMX partial's buttons were stripped by the innerHTML guard during swap. Fixed: converted to `data-action` + `data-tool-id`.

4. **Tool delegation bound to `#toolBody` (HTMX-injected)** — `#toolBody` doesn't exist at `DOMContentLoaded` since it's loaded via HTMX. Fixed: bound to `#tool-ops-main-content-wrapper` (stable parent in admin.html) with fallback.

5. **RBAC mutation scrubber narrowed too aggressively** — Defense-in-depth selector was changed from broad `onclick*=` to narrow `data-action` only, losing coverage for other entity tables (servers, resources, prompts, etc.). Fixed: union of both selector patterns.

6. **`teams_selector_items.html` dead `onclick`** — Template still emitted `onclick` that was always stripped by the guard. Removed.

### Test coverage added

- **18 Playwright tests** covering all 18 affected locations from the PR
- Tests exercise real production functions (not just pattern simulation) with route interception for network-dependent paths
- Integration test for `selectServerForChat` verifies no runtime error and correct CSS class toggling
- Iframe guard test uses synthetic innerHTML injection to genuinely prove guard activity (not tautological)

### Verification

All tests pass against live deployment:
- **18 passed, 2 skipped** (tool table + global search skip due to no data in test env)
- Team selector E2E: dropdown opens, onclick stripped, click navigates with `?team_id=`
- innerHTML guard: onclick stripped, data-action + data-id survive
- All data-action → addEventListener wiring verified for: metrics retry, auth headers, import controls, public team join, log viewer delegation, security/audit correlation, chat server selection, token retry, team search retry

### Security

- No new XSS vectors — `data-*` attributes are inert, user data still escapes via `escapeHtml()`
- innerHTML guard not weakened or bypassed
- RBAC client-side defense-in-depth coverage restored for all entity tables

### Files changed (review additions)

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `mcpgateway/static/admin.js` | Chat server dataset fix, tool selector fixes, null guards, RBAC union selector, delegation on stable wrapper |
| `mcpgateway/templates/toolops_partial.html` | Convert 5 buttons from onclick to data-action |
| `mcpgateway/templates/teams_selector_items.html` | Remove dead onclick |
| `tests/playwright/test_innerhtml_guard.py` | 18 regression tests for all data-action paths |
| `tests/playwright/test_organization.py` | Team selector dropdown E2E test |
| `tests/playwright/test_admin_url_context.py` | Iframe guard proof with synthetic injection |

commits.message:
fix: use dataset lookup instead of onclick.toString() in chat server selection

selectServerForChat() used item.onclick.toString().includes(serverId)
to highlight the selected server. With inline onclick removed by the
innerHTML guard, item.onclick is null and this throws TypeError.

Replace with item.dataset.serverId === serverId which uses the
data-server-id attribute set during rendering.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: convert tool-ops template to data-action, fix selectors and null-derefs

The PR converted loadTools() JS markup to data-action but left:
- toolops_partial.html server-rendered buttons with inline onclick
  (stripped by innerHTML guard during HTMX swap)
- enrichTool/generateToolTestCases/validateTool button-state selectors
  using [onclick*=...] which return null after the conversion
- Unguarded enrichButton/tcgButton access causing TypeError
- RBAC button-removal selector using [onclick*=...] patterns
- Delegation handler bound to #toolBody (HTMX-injected, may not
  exist at DOMContentLoaded)

Fixes:
- Convert toolops_partial.html buttons to data-action + data-tool-id
- Replace all [onclick*=...] tool selectors with [data-action=...]
- Guard enrichButton and tcgButton before property access
- Update RBAC selector to match data-action attributes
- Bind delegation to #tool-ops-main-content-wrapper (stable parent
  present at DOMContentLoaded) with fallback to #toolBody

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: restore broad RBAC scrubber coverage, strengthen test proofs

Address Codex review round 2 findings:

1. RBAC mutation scrubber (defense-in-depth): restore inline onclick
   selectors alongside new data-action selectors so the client-side
   fallback covers all entity tables, not just tool-ops.

2. Iframe guard test: replace tautological hasOnclick check (template
   no longer emits onclick) with a synthetic innerHTML injection that
   genuinely proves the guard strips on* attributes inside iframes.

3. Chat server test: add integration test that runs the real
   selectServerForChat function (no stub) and verifies no runtime
   error, correct highlight class toggling, and state update.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
